_comment: Perk adapter: Everdamned 1.7.0 (vampirism overhaul with a Blood Magic tree). Its Vitae holder perk
(Vitae refills from Vampiric Drain 'and similar effects') and Blood Resonance (melee hits on a target
under a Hemomancy spell refill Vitae) ask EPMagic_SpellHasKeyword / HasMagicEffectKeyword
ED_Mechanics_Keyword_Hemomancy, which Everdamned.esp puts only on its own blood spells.
Conditions as hemomancy.json: blood damage and blood drains.
Not given: the ED_Mechanics_Keyword_BloodCost* and DeductBloodCost keywords - they make Everdamned's own
spells cost Vitae; other blood spells pay their own cost.
